scope: Timeline index for the nine current unique Xbox screen recordings.

inspectionPolicy.masterHandling: Master videos were inspected read-only and were not renamed, trimmed, recompressed, overwritten, or copied into this repository by this task.
inspectionPolicy.derivativeHandling: Local contact sheets and frame crops used for inspection are ignored derivatives under data/audit/college-football-27/local-evidence/prompt84-timeline/.
inspectionPolicy.selectedOptionPolicy: A native option label is recorded only when the selected-state UI label was directly readable. Neighboring thumbnail labels or swatches are not promoted to selected options.
inspectionPolicy.timestampPrecision: Nearest-second visual inspection from 1 fps contact sheets with spot keyframe inspection for ambiguous selected labels.
inspectionPolicy.catalogUsePolicy: These events are research timeline observations only and must not be imported as verified production catalog records without the separate audit, evidence, and second-verifier workflow.
